get.description:
Report the character's language-hardening mode. Reads only.

Exists because a caller that can only SET cannot ask "what is it now?"
without choosing a value to write. A client that reads by writing its
guess overwrites the author's choice every time the screen is opened —
measured on dev19, where opening Core AI Settings put `off` back to
`default` on every page load, so the toggle could never stay off.

character_id.title: Character Id
character_id.description: Single-character UUID, optionally followed by -draft, -latest, or a major.minor[.patch] version. Roster entries currently accept bare UUIDs only.

vision_prompt_mode.title: Vision Prompt Mode
vision_prompt_mode.description: Controls Core-owned vision instructions and visual-input tooling for this session. 'auto' preserves legacy runtime behavior; 'disabled' omits the vision prompt and suppresses visual input while retaining scene metadata and other text context.

group_chat.title: Group Chat
group_chat.description: Opt a multi-character room into moderated group chat. Only a room created with this flag receives server-authored room context, roster republishes and directed group-address turns; a roster room without it behaves exactly as multi-character V0 does. Set at create; a join inherits whatever the room was created with.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Shared Workspace whose characters fill a multi-character room created by a member with their own API key. Core authorizes every seat with a Workspace preview grant issued for that member, runs the room on the Workspace runtime credential and records the member as its actor. The member is the speaker, so end_user_id and end_user_metadata must be absent. Only valid with characters and mode='create'.

shared_session_key.title: Shared Session Key
shared_session_key.description: Client-provided grouping key used to deterministically place participants into the same shared session/room.

connect_attempt_id.title: Connect Attempt Id
connect_attempt_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for one logical connection attempt. Retries with the same key and payload replay the original response.

request_trace_id.title: Request Trace Id
request_trace_id.description: Server-side request trace ID for correlating client events, logs, telemetry, and session records for this /connect request

room_url.title: Room Url

end_user_id.title: End User Id
end_user_id.description: The end_user_id associated with this session when provided

end_user_metadata.title: End User Metadata
end_user_metadata.description: Metadata associated with the end user

memory_status.title: Memory Status
memory_status.description: What long-term memory will do for this session: 'disabled', 'active', or 'skipped_no_end_user' when the character has memory enabled but no end_user_id was supplied, so nothing will be remembered. Reported positively rather than left to be inferred from an absent end_user_id.

The setting AND the prompt text it currently resolves to.

`resolved_block` is the exact string appended to the system prompt for
this character. It is returned so a client can show the author what the
backend actually sends instead of paraphrasing it — if the two ever
disagree, the displayed text stops being trustworthy.

VisionInputConfig.title: VisionInputConfig
VisionInputConfig.description:
Vision context injection settings for discrete multimodal LLMs.

Frames are sampled from the video channel, buffered silently, and attached
to the next LLM-triggering turn. max_resolution=None uses the provider-aware
default (Gemini 384px for the single-tile token rate, others 768px).
